name: captain
description: A coordinator for coding runs, with a time box only when the owner names one, shared as a team plugin — one main session that coordinates background subagents in git worktrees and does the light work (reads, git inspection, notes) itself, with Codex reviews first (Opus when Codex is not installed), a 15-minute health check, and destructive or outward actions queued for the user at the end of the run. Run /captain:captain-setup once first to choose notifications and quiet hours. Code and functionality only; not for production, devops or external writes beyond listed dev targets.
